exposure: Type of hearing device (bone-conduction, contralateral routing of signal aid, conventional hearing aids)
outcome: Referral to and engagement with support services
Concerns reported by children, parents, clinicians, or teachers
cohort: 63 children with permanent congenital unilateral hearing loss (UHL) at a tertiary referral center in Nottingham, UK.
finding: Most children with UHL trialled and used hearing devices, primarily in school settings, highlighting the need for better understanding of device efficacy and targeted support services to address individual concerns and optimize outcomes.
